summary: Share configured slice normalization between launch and recovery (unit 8c)

rules.detail: Admission and recovery remain inactive; the heavy slice remains configuration-only.

compatibility.detail: Recovery discovery reuses launch's slice_name normalization and validation before comparing keeper properties. Slash-qualified configuration such as app.slice/app-capped.slice/app-capped-heavy.slice now identifies the same keeper before and after restart, covered by a shared-configuration launch/recovery regression test.

downtime.detail: No live behavior or deployment changes.

recovery.detail: Accepted slash-qualified heavy slices no longer falsely fail keeper discovery after restart. No launch, retry or release capability is added.
